onprem.capexPerKW: Capital expenditure per kW of IT load for facility build-out
onprem.softCostsPct: Percentage of hard costs for permits, design, project management
onprem.maintPct: Annual maintenance cost as percentage of total build cost
onprem.staffingPerYr: Annual cost for dedicated facility staff (engineers, operators)
onprem.insurancePerYr: Annual insurance cost for facility and equipment
onprem.waccPct: Weighted Average Cost of Capital for annuity calculations
onprem.depreciationYears: Number of years for equipment depreciation
onprem.hoursPerYear: Hours in a year for energy calculations
onprem.energyConversionFactor: Conversion factor from kW to MWh (kW*hours/1000)

colo.euroPerKWMonth: Monthly cost per kW of IT load for rack space and power
colo.crossConnectPerMonth: Monthly cost for cross-connect to carrier networks
colo.bandwidthPerGbpsMonth: Monthly cost per Gbps of internet bandwidth
colo.passThroughEnergy: Whether energy costs are passed through to customer
colo.compliancePct: Compliance overhead as percentage of base colo cost

cloud.computePerMonth: Base monthly cost for compute instances
cloud.storageEuroPerGBMo: Monthly cost per GB of storage
cloud.egressEuroPerGB: Cost per GB of data egress from cloud
cloud.supportPct: Support cost as percentage of compute + storage + egress

defaults.pue: Power Usage Effectiveness - ratio of total facility power to IT power
defaults.energyPrice: Energy price in euros per MWh
defaults.minCapacityPct: Minimum capacity percentage to ensure realistic scaling
defaults.egressAsStoragePct: Percentage of storage assumed to be egressed monthly
